doc.summary: The Breaking News Override module injects dynamic text updates into the game client by reading a configuration file and injecting payloads via packet hooks.
doc.body:
# Breaking News Override Module

## Overview
This C++ module enhances server communication by allowing administrators to push custom "Breaking News" messages directly to connected players. It operates as an overlay system that intercepts specific network packets to inject formatted text, ensuring updates are delivered without requiring a full client restart.

## How It Works
The module functions through a two-part architecture: a **World Script** and a **Server Script**. 
1. **Initialization**: Upon server startup or configuration reload, the `BreakingNewsWorldScript` triggers via the `OnAfterConfigLoad` hook. It checks if the feature is enabled in the config and, if so, calls `LoadBreakingNews()` to read the content from the specified HTML file.
2. **Formatting**: The raw text is parsed using `TryReadFile`, cleaned of line breaks, and formatted into a final string using `Acore::StringFormat`.
3. **Injection**: When a client sends a character enumeration packet (`SMSG_CHAR_ENUM`), the `BreakingNewsServerScript` intercepts this via the `CanPacketSend` hook. If enabled and content exists, it constructs a payload and uses `SendChunkedPayload` to transmit the data in manageable chunks to the warden.

## Key Functions and Classes
- **`BreakingNewsWorldScript`**: Handles global configuration loading. Its `OnAfterConfigLoad` method reads the enable flag and triggers the news loading process.
- **`TryReadFile`**: A utility function that opens a file path, reads its contents line-by-line, and returns a cleaned string buffer.
- **`TryReadNews`**: Orchestrates the file reading process by retrieving the HTML path from `sConfigMgr` and calling `TryReadFile`.
- **`GetChunks`**: Splits a large payload string into smaller segments based on a defined chunk size, optimizing network transmission.
- **`SendChunkedPayload`**: Registers the payload with the `WardenPayloadMgr`, forces client-side checks, and iterates through chunks to send them sequentially.
- **`CanPacketSend`**: The core hook logic. It verifies if the feature is active, checks for valid warden sessions, and determines if a packet should be intercepted for injection.

## Usage for Operators and Developers
To activate this module, server operators must configure the following options in their configuration file:
- **`BreakingNews.Enable`**: Set to `true` to activate the feature.
- **`BreakingNews.HtmlPath`**: Specify the relative path to the HTML file containing the news text (default: `./Updates.html`).
- **`BreakingNews.Title`**: Define the headline for the message (default: `Breaking News`).

Developers can extend functionality by modifying the chunk size in `GetChunks` or customizing the payload format within `SendChunkedPayload`. The module automatically handles packet interception, requiring no additional command-line flags beyond standard server configuration.

doc.summary: Attempts to read a file specified by path into the provided string reference, returning false on failure and true on success.
doc.overview: This function opens an input stream using the given file path and reads its entire contents line by line. It concatenates all lines into the output string while stripping carriage returns and newlines to ensure clean text data. The operation returns a boolean indicating whether the file was successfully opened and read.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path to open for reading.

params.name: bn_Result
params.desc: A reference to a string that will be populated with the file's contents (without line breaks).

doc.notes: The function modifies the content of bn_Result by removing newline characters. Callers should ensure the path is valid and has appropriate permissions.

doc.summary: Attempts to read the breaking news HTML file from a configured path and populates the result string.
doc.overview: This function retrieves the title configuration and then attempts to read an HTML file specified by the 'BreakingNews.HtmlPath' option. It uses a mutex lock to safely access the global 'bn_Title' variable before proceeding with the file I/O operation, returning false if either the path is missing or the file cannot be read.

params.name: bn_Result
params.desc: Output parameter that will contain the contents of the breaking news HTML file upon successful execution.

doc.notes: Caller must ensure 'bn_Mutex' is valid; returns false if the configured path is empty or the file read fails.

doc.summary: Splits a given string into fixed-size substrings and returns them as a vector.
doc.overview: This function takes an input string and a chunk size, then iterates through the string to extract substrings of that specific length. Each extracted substring is added to a result vector which is returned to the caller. The logic ensures that the final chunk may be shorter than the specified chunkSize if the original string does not end on a multiple of that boundary.

params.name: s
params.desc: The input string to be split into chunks.

params.name: chunkSize
params.desc: The desired size for each chunk in the resulting vector.

doc.summary: Sends a breaking news payload to the warden in three parts (pre, mid, and post) by registering and queuing chunks while forcing immediate checks.
doc.overview: This function divides a given payload string into smaller chunks based on the specified chunk size. It registers and queues a pre-payload, then iterates through each chunk to register and queue it as a separate payload before forcing an immediate check on the warden. Finally, it handles the post-payload in the same manner, ensuring all components are processed sequentially.

params.name: warden
params.desc: Pointer to the Warden object that receives the forced checks.

params.name: payloadMgr
params.desc: Pointer to the WardenPayloadManager used to register and queue payloads.

params.name: payload
params.desc: The complete payload string to be split into chunks.

params.name: chunkSize
params.desc: The maximum size of each chunk in the payload.

doc.notes: Calls GetChunks, RegisterPayload, QueuePayload, and ForceChecks on the warden. Edge case: if verbose logging is enabled, it logs pre-payload, mid-payload chunks, and post-payload details.

doc.summary: Loads the breaking news title and body from configuration and file storage, then updates global state with formatted content.
doc.overview: This function retrieves the breaking news title from the configuration manager using a default value if not specified. It attempts to read the news body from a file via TryReadNews, logging an error and returning early if the operation fails. Upon success, it acquires a mutex lock before updating global variables with the raw title, body, and formatted string.
doc.side_effects: Global state (bn_Title, bn_Body, bn_Formatted), I/O (file read)
doc.notes: Callers should ensure TryReadNews handles missing files gracefully; the function returns early on failure without modifying global state.

doc.summary: OnAfterConfigLoad initializes the Breaking News system by reading the enable flag from configuration and updating the global state.
doc.overview: This function is invoked immediately after the server's configuration has been fully loaded to ensure the Breaking News feature respects its enabled/disabled setting. It retrieves the boolean option 'BreakingNews.Enable' from the configuration manager, defaulting to false if not specified, and atomically updates the internal flag using a mutex lock to prevent race conditions during initialization. If the feature is disabled, the function exits early; otherwise, it proceeds to load any pre-defined news items.
doc.notes: Must be called exactly once after config loading completes. LoadBreakingNews may perform additional side effects such as network requests or file reads.

doc.summary: The Breaking News Override module injects dynamic HTML updates into the game client by reading a configured file and chunking it for delivery. It operates via two scripts: a WorldScript that triggers on config reload, and a ServerScript that intercepts packets to deliver the formatted content.
doc.body:
# Breaking News Override Module The **Breaking News Override** module is designed to inject custom HTML updates directly into the game client's UI without requiring a full server restart. It achieves this by reading a text file containing the news content, formatting it with a title and body, and then chunking the payload for efficient delivery over the network. ## How It Works The module operates through a two-script architecture that ensures reliability and performance: 1. **Initialization**: When the server starts or configuration is reloaded, the `BreakingNewsWorldScript` triggers via the `WORLDHOOK_ON_AFTER_CONFIG_LOAD`. It checks if the feature is enabled in the config and, if so, calls `LoadBreakingNews()` to read the file and format the text. 2. **Formatting**: The raw content is combined with a title using `Acore::StringFormat` to create a final HTML string (`bn_Formatted`). 3. **Delivery**: A separate `BreakingNewsServerScript` hooks into the packet system via `SERVERHOOK_CAN_PACKET_SEND`. When a specific character enumeration packet (`SMSG_CHAR_ENUM`) is detected, it checks if news should be sent. If enabled and content exists, it splits the large HTML string into smaller chunks using `GetChunks()` and queues them for delivery to the warden. ## Key Functions and Classes * **`BreakingNewsWorldScript`**: Handles the initial loading of configuration and file reading. It uses `TryReadFile` to safely read the content from the specified path and removes carriage returns and newlines before formatting. * **`BreakingNewsServerScript`**: Manages the packet interception logic. Its `CanPacketSend` function determines if a payload should be sent, while `SendChunkedPayload` handles the actual transmission using the Warden Payload Manager. * **`TryReadFile`**: A utility function that opens a file stream, reads line by line, and concatenates the buffer into a single string, stripping whitespace characters (`\r`, `\n`). * **`GetChunks`**: Splits a large string into smaller substrings based on a defined chunk size to prevent packet overflow. ## Configuration and Hooks Server operators can control the module's behavior through specific config keys: * **`BreakingNews.Enable`** (bool): Enables or disables the entire feature. Default is `false`. * **`BreakingNews.HtmlPath`** (string): The file path to the HTML content. Default is `./Updates.html`. * **`BreakingNews.Title`** (string): The title prefix for the news block. Default is `Breaking News`. * **`BreakingNews.Verbose`** (bool): If true, logs information about sent payloads. Default is `false`. The module relies on two specific hooks to function: 1. **`WORLDHOOK_ON_AFTER_CONFIG_LOAD`**: Triggered by `BreakingNewsWorldScript` to ensure the news content is loaded before any packets are processed. 2. **`SERVERHOOK_CAN_PACKET_SEND`**: Triggered by `BreakingNewsServerScript` to intercept and inject the payload into the client stream. ## Usage Example To activate the module, add the following configuration options to your server's config file: ```ini [BreakingNews] Enable = true HtmlPath = ./Updates.html Title = Server Update Alert Verbose = false ``` Once enabled, the module will inject the following HTML content into the client's UI (saved to `./Updates.html`): ```html

Server Update Alert

Welcome to the new era of gameplay! We have implemented several major changes including updated maps, new classes, and improved performance. Please ensure your client is up to date.

```

doc.summary: The Breaking News Override module injects customizable HTML content into the character screen upon login, using a server-side script to read files and a world script to manage configuration.
doc.body:
# Breaking News Override Module ## Overview This C++ module enhances the AzerothCore game server by injecting custom breaking news messages directly onto the player's character screen. It reads content from an HTML file specified in the configuration, formats it with a title, and delivers it via a chunked payload system to ensure smooth transmission across network conditions. ## How It Works The module operates through two primary scripts: `BreakingNewsWorldScript` and `BreakingNewsServerScript`. 1. **Initialization**: When the server starts or configuration reloads, `OnAfterConfigLoad` in `BreakingNewsWorldScript` checks if the feature is enabled via `BreakingNews.Enable`. If active, it triggers `LoadBreakingNews()`. 2. **Content Loading**: `LoadBreakingNews()` retrieves the title and body content using `TryReadNews()`, which internally calls `TryReadFile()` to read the HTML file defined by `BreakingNews.HtmlPath`. The content is then formatted into a single string using `Acore::StringFormat`. 3. **Packet Delivery**: During gameplay, `CanPacketSend()` intercepts packets (specifically `SMSG_CHAR_ENUM`) to inject the news payload. If enabled, it constructs a chunked payload using `GetChunks()` and sends it via `SendChunkedPayload()` to the target warden. ## Key Functions and Classes - **`BreakingNewsWorldScript`**: Handles world-side logic, specifically reading configuration options and initializing the news content on startup. - **`BreakingNewsServerScript`**: Manages server-side packet interception and payload construction. It includes: - `TryReadFile`: Reads a file into a string buffer, stripping carriage returns and newlines. - `TryReadNews`: Orchestrates reading the HTML file and storing title/body in mutex-protected variables. - `GetChunks`: Splits a string into smaller segments based on a specified chunk size. - `SendChunkedPayload`: Queues the payload with the warden's payload manager and forces checks to ensure delivery. ## Server Operator Usage To activate the module, edit `conf/breakingnews.conf.dist`: - **`BreakingNews.Enable`**: Set to `1` to enable the feature (default is `0`). - **`BreakingNews.Title`**: Customize the header text (default: "Breaking News"). - **`BreakingNews.HtmlPath`**: Specify the path to your HTML file (default: `./breakingnews.html`). - **`BreakingNews.Cache`**: Set to `1` to cache content on startup, or `0` to refresh every login. - **`BreakingNews.Verbose`**: Enable for debugging logs (default: `0`). ## Usage Example ### Configuration File (`conf/breakingnews.conf.dist`) ```ini [worldserver] BreakingNews.Enable = 1 BreakingNews.Title = "Server Maintenance Alert" BreakingNews.HtmlPath = "/home/azerothcore/html/maintenance.html" BreakingNews.Cache = 1 BreakingNews.Verbose = 0 ``` ### Injected Content File (`maintenance.html`) ```html

Server Maintenance Alert

The scheduled maintenance window will begin at 03:00 UTC. All services may be temporarily unavailable during this period.

Please save your progress and log out before the scheduled time.

```

doc.summary: The BreakingNewsOverride module injects formatted HTML content into the character screen via a Lua payload, allowing server operators to display custom updates without modifying client-side code.
doc.body:
# Breaking News Override Module This C++ module intercepts network packets to inject a "Breaking News" message directly onto the player's character screen. It reads an HTML file specified in the configuration, formats it with colored labels and links, and transmits it as a chunked Lua payload using the `ServerAlertText` frame. ## How It Works The module operates through two main scripts: `BreakingNewsWorldScript` and `BreakingNewsServerScript`. The flow begins when the server loads configuration; if enabled, the world script reads the HTML file and formats it into a string. This formatted string is then passed to the server script, which monitors incoming packets. When a character enumeration packet (`SMSG_CHAR_ENUM`) is received, the module checks if the payload should be sent. If so, it splits the message into 128-byte chunks and queues them as a Lua payload for the client to render. ## Key Functions and Classes ### `BreakingNewsWorldScript` This script handles initialization and configuration loading. - **Constructor**: Registers itself with the `WORLDHOOK_ON_AFTER_CONFIG_LOAD` hook. - **`OnAfterConfigLoad(bool reload)`**: Checks if the module is enabled via `BreakingNews.Enable`. doc.summary: The Breaking News Override module injects formatted HTML content into the character screen via Lua payloads, allowing server operators to display custom updates without modifying client-side code.
doc.body:
# Breaking News Override Module ## Overview This C++ module intercepts packet transmission to inject a "Breaking News" alert into the game's character screen. It reads an HTML file specified by configuration, formats it with color codes and headers, and sends it as a chunked Lua payload using the `ServerAlertText` frame mechanism. ## How It Works The module operates through two main scripts: `BreakingNewsWorldScript` and `BreakingNewsServerScript`. The flow is as follows: 1. **Initialization**: On server startup (or config reload), `OnAfterConfigLoad` checks if the feature is enabled. 2. **Loading**: If enabled, `TryReadFile` reads the HTML content from the configured path, which is then stored in a mutex-protected buffer. 3. **Formatting**: The raw text is formatted using `Acore::StringFormat` to wrap it in the module's Lua payload structure. 4. **Injection**: When a character packet is about to send, `CanPacketSend` checks if the news should be displayed. If so, `SendChunkedPayload` breaks the message into 128-byte chunks and queues them as a pre-payload. ## Key Functions and Classes | Component | Description | |-----------|-------------| | `BreakingNewsWorldScript` | Handles world-side logic, specifically reading configuration and loading the news file on startup. | | `BreakingNewsServerScript` | Handles server-side packet interception, chunking the payload, and sending it to the client. | | `TryReadFile` | Reads the HTML file from disk into a string buffer, stripping carriage returns and newlines. | | `TryReadNews` | Retrieves the path and title from configuration before attempting to read the file. | | `GetChunks` | Splits a string into smaller segments based on a specified chunk size (default 128 bytes). | | `SendChunkedPayload` | Registers the payload with the Warden system and forces checks to ensure delivery. | ## Configuration The module uses the following configuration keys found in `conf/breakingnews.conf.dist`: | Option | Type | Default | Description | |--------|------|---------|-------------| | `BreakingNews.Enable` | bool | 0 (Disabled) | Enables or disables the breaking news feature. | | `BreakingNews.Title` | string | "Breaking News" | The title displayed above the news body. | | `BreakingNews.HtmlPath` | string | "./breakingnews.html" | Path to the HTML file containing the news content. | | `BreakingNews.Cache` | bool | 1 (Enabled) | Caches the news on startup; set to 0 to refresh every login. | | `BreakingNews.Verbose` | bool | 0 (Disabled) | Enables verbose logging for debugging purposes. | ## Usage Example ### Configuration File (`conf/breakingnews.conf.dist`) ```ini [worldserver] BreakingNews.Enable = 1 BreakingNews.Title = "Server Update" BreakingNews.HtmlPath = "/path/to/news.html" BreakingNews.Cache = 1 BreakingNews.Verbose = 0 ``` ### Injected Content File (`/path/to/news.html`) ```html

|cffD4AF37Server Update|r


|cffD4AF37Patch Notes:|r We have implemented smooth Catmull-Rom pathing and fixed passenger positions on player mounts.


|cffD4AF37Bug Fixes:|r Numerous other bugs have been fixed, averaging 5 per week this year.


|cffD4AF37Note:|r Changelogs are hereafter posted on our website instead of Discord.


Website | Discord

```
